title: Read comment threads on the Board and answer them in Screens

trigger.text: Dex presented a ticket's screens on the Board and answered Dana's earlier comments.

goal: Dana sees which screens still have open threads and reads them on the Board without opening every screen; she answers in the Screens view.
outcome: Every thread on the ticket's screens is answered or resolved; the Board shows no open count for them.

inputs.source: Shared board state set by the agent

example.body: Button label should say the amount.

steps.action: Shows the ticket's screens on the Board; each tile shows pins on its elements and count chips in its name bar
Scans the count chips and picks the tile with unanswered and detached threads
Clicks a pin (never hover); a read-only preview at the pin shows the latest messages, author and status
steps.note: Click, Enter or Space opens it; Esc or a click outside closes it. No reply or resolve on the Board.

steps.action: Chooses Open in Screens in the preview
Replies to the thread in the Screens view, mentioning the agent
Resolves the threads that are done; back on the Board the tile's count drops

branches.title: A thread lost its element

steps.action: Clicks the amber pin at the frame's top-left; the preview names the last known node and says the thread lost its element
Chooses Open in Screens to move the thread to another element there
steps.note: Opens comments-detached in the Screens view.

branches.outcome: The thread is re-anchored or deleted on the canvas; the Board count follows.

branches.title: The Board is zoomed out below 60%

steps.action: Shows one count dot per screen inside the tile's top-left instead of per-element pins
Clicks a dot; the screen's read-only thread list opens at the dot
Picks a row; that thread opens in the Screens view

branches.outcome: Dana answers the thread in Screens without zooming the Board in.
